choice.basis: The chart title explicitly states 'Falling Respiratory Infection Cases' and the plotted line shows a downward trend from its 2022 peak to the 2023 endpoint. This visual evidence of a recent decline aligns with the 'easing-activity' option, whereas the net upward trend from 2012 contradicts the title's 'falling' description.
choice.option_label: Route the record to easing-activity follow-up
